spec.text: Image 1 is the man's model sheet, image 2 is the woman's model sheet, image 3 is the approved couple in their wedding outfits. Draw the SAME couple together in their casual outfits from images 1 and 2, full bodies, front view with a slight inward turn, inner hands joined, feet on one ground line, the man a little taller. Identical faces, glasses, hair and four-head adult proportions as image 3. Warm matte clay and gouache storybook finish. Plain warm ivory background, soft contact shadows. No text, no extra people, no photorealism.
